profile.name: Lei Xu
profile.position: Postdoctoral Researcher · KTH Royal Institute of Technology
profile.positionZh: 博士后研究员 · 瑞典皇家理工学院 KTH
profile.introEn: My research focuses on distributed optimization and learning over networked systems, with particular emphasis on communication-efficient algorithms, zeroth-order methods, stochastic optimization, and rigorous convergence analysis.
profile.introZh: 我的研究聚焦网络化系统中的分布式优化与学习，重点关注通信高效算法、零阶优化方法、随机优化及严格的收敛性分析。
profile.aboutEn: I am a Postdoctoral Researcher in Decision and Control Systems at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, working with Prof. Karl H. Johansson. I received my Ph.D. from the University of Victoria in 2025 under the supervision of Prof. Yang Shi.
profile.aboutZh: 我目前在瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）决策与控制系统部门从事博士后研究，与 Karl H. Johansson 教授合作。我于 2025 年获得加拿大维多利亚大学博士学位，博士导师为 Yang Shi（施阳）教授。

metrics.noteEn: As reported in the June 2026 research application. Published and accepted papers after that date are not included in this historical snapshot.
metrics.noteZh: 依据 2026 年 6 月申请书中的统计；该历史统计不含此后新增录用或发表的论文。

lineage.descriptionEn: A historical overview of my academic mentorship lineage.
lineage.descriptionZh: 我的学术师承谱系简史。

papers.title: Distributed Nonconvex Optimization With Event-Triggered Communication
papers.desc: Dynamic event-triggered communication for distributed nonconvex optimization, with convergence guarantees and exclusion of Zeno behavior.
papers.zh: 面向分布式非凸优化设计动态事件触发通信机制，建立收敛性保证并排除 Zeno 现象。

papers.title: Compressed Gradient Tracking Algorithms for Distributed Nonconvex Optimization
papers.desc: Communication-compressed gradient tracking for distributed nonconvex optimization, covering multiple compressor models.
papers.zh: 研究多类压缩机制下的分布式非凸梯度跟踪算法及其收敛性质。

papers.title: A Zeroth-Order Compressed Push–Pull Algorithm for Distributed Nonconvex Optimization Over Unbalanced Directed Graphs
papers.desc: Zeroth-order push–pull optimization with compressed communication over unbalanced directed networks.
papers.zh: 研究非平衡有向网络中结合函数值反馈与压缩通信的零阶 push–pull 分布式非凸优化。

papers.title: Quantized Distributed Nonconvex Optimization Algorithms With Linear Convergence Under the Polyak–Łojasiewicz Condition
papers.desc: Quantized distributed nonconvex optimization with linear convergence under the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition.
papers.zh: 提出量化分布式非凸优化算法，并在 Polyak–Łojasiewicz 条件下证明线性收敛。

papers.title: Almost Sure Stability and Stabilization of Markovian Jump Systems With Stochastic Switching
papers.desc: Almost-sure stability and stabilization of Markovian jump systems subject to additional stochastic switching.
papers.zh: 研究具有附加随机切换的 Markov 跳变系统的几乎必然稳定性及稳定化。
